notes.title: Server Update 2018.19: "Ulverston"
notes.content:
Two more item updates for the holidays!

[b]Pet Cage[/b]

Let's face it -- android cats and dogs are [i]totes[/i] adorbs, but they're also rather cold and pointy. Sometimes you just wanna snuggle up to a real, live, cuddly critter (not including you, pet terrapus! Stop spewing ink on me, gross!)

Fortunately, we're pleased to introduce the luxurious [b]Pet Cage[/b] -- an all-purpose pet trapping container! Just trap a bunny, skunk, crow, vulture, or terrapus with a Pet Cage and you'll find yourself with a domesticated critter in your inventory that you can put anywhere! They come pre-named like any good pet (and hopefully we can add a custom naming feature soon!) And the non-terrapus critters even have a cute bell collar.

[b]Vault[/b]

This item has long been awaiting addition into the game, so let's get it launched! The [b]Vault[/b] is a super-impressive looking container to house your rarest rares. It's for when you want to show off your showing off! Simply place your vault and then your rares inside, and everyone will know you you're a serious collector.

Note:
Both of these items will be exclusive to the shop for a limited time, then turn into rare root.

notes.title: Server Update 2018.18: "Tottenham"
notes.content:
We've made lots of enhancements on the PC client over the last several months, and this server release caps it off with full world machine goodness for the holidays! In addition to [b]world machines working 100% on PC[/b] and the addition of the [b]onyx weather machine[/b] last week, this release includes the follow features:

- All world machine blueprints are now [b]lootable[/b]
- All world machines are now [b]craftable[/b]
- World machines can be [b]dismantled[/b] and moved from world to world

Other good news:

- We're adding more ways to [b]earn crowns[/b] in-game
- [b]Mob spawning rates[/b] have increased 50%

There will be a couple other awesome features arriving soon as well, so stay tuned!

notes.title: Server Update 2018.17: "Sevenoaks"

- Turn OFF liquid gravity! It's time to make some waterfalls or floating lakes or whatever you can dream up! (hat tip to Detech for the idea!)
- Turn ON double speed plant growth!

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]:

- World machines are now useable on PC / Android
- Permanent rain no longer stops plant growth

[b]Coming next[/b]:

- Craftable and upgradeable world machines
- Dismantling world machines

notes.title: Server Update 2018.16: "Pocklington"
notes.content:
Phase one of Daily Challenges are arriving! 🎉

Starting today at Daily Loot O'Clock (6 PM EST), the first daily challenge will begin. It's a deepworld classic pastime: hunt down normal adult terrapi! Every time you score against the challenge, you'll see a message +1 challenge pt (10). (The number in parentheses is your ongoing daily score.)

Each day at 6 PM a new Daily Challenge will start, and you'll see an alert about what the challenge is. Right now there's no threshold to win anything -- it's purely competitive, to see who can do the best. You can view the leaderboard at http://www.deepworldgame.com/players.

May the best terrapus hunter win!

In the future:

- Daily loot will be acquired by achieving a threshold in the Daily Challenge rather than a single XP amount
- The codex will display past challenges, with a focus on the winners
- In-game announcements of the prior challenge's winners
- In-game leaderboards

notes.title: Server Update 2018.13: "Macroom"
notes.content:
I'll be traveling later this week so I thought I'd get the next update out the door early!

This new server release launches SEVERE and EXTREME worlds for your exploratory pleasure. What does this mean?

- SEVERE or EXTREME environmental conditions matching that of the new weather machine (e.g., much faster/stronger heat, cold, and supernovae)
- A higher ratio of dungeons to bunkers
- A higher ratio of hostile mobs spawned vs peaceful ones
- Teleporters cannot be placed in EXTREME worlds

And a bonus:

- Slightly more new worlds overall!

Hope you enjoy that 20-30 second supernova interval XD

notes.title: Server Update 2018.12: "Larkhall"
notes.content:
Fun update today! We are introducing the BRASS and DIAMOND WEATHER MACHINES:

BRASS WEATHER MACHINE:
- Control the day/night cycle - make it fast, slow, realtime (and set your time zone!), or always day or night.
- Control the rain cycle - normal, always raining, or never raining.

DIAMOND WEATHER MACHINE:
- Control the environmental danger level
- "Pleasant": no environmental damage (including supernovas)
- "Dangerous": standard acidity / heat / cold / supernovas
- "Severe": double heat & cold damage / supernovas
- "Extreme": quadruple heat & cold damage / supernovas

This item is available only in the shop for now, but it will be craftable in a future update.

OTHER UPDATES:
- Added combat accessory blueprints to loot! You can now craft all three scopes
- To go along with the weather machine, we've made heat & cold affect players with high survival again (e.g., no more total immunity). Your time to thirst / frost is now a sliding scale from 5 minutes to 30 minutes, depending on your skill level. "Severe" and "Extreme" weather machine settings shrink that duration as well as causing more damage. Who's ready for some survival worlds??

notes.title: Client Update 3.10.3
notes.content:
Lots of work on the universal client lately, most of it to prepare for Android support (our android build is currently in alpha). A lot of that was mobile-specific, but moving forward there will be more things that benefit all platforms (performance and missing features like emotes, etc.) So look out for that soon!

This release also links up unity's error reporting, so hopefully we can figure out why the game starts to glitch out randomly for some people.

Also releasing some formerly forgotten-about items!

- All chests and sacks now provide loot to anyone within 5 seconds of opening (*mech chests still require raiding participation)
- Non-premium players can now loot anything, but premium players still get double crown loot
- Added mayflower and autumn paintings to bunkers
- Added all musical instruments to bunkers
- Added onyx protector blueprint to loot (craft giga protectors)
- Added Grandmaster and Legendary Recycler achievements
- Added mayflower, gong, and nessie to shop
- Added camo facepaint to loot
- Made loot spawn more often in sacks and crates
- Made rare mounted heads and paintings spawn more often
- Made onyx spawn more often
- Made empty caves spawn less often
- Made weak mobs a little weaker
